Set up your OpenFrame library

OpenFrame keeps your projects and your Global Idea Vault in one folder, your OpenFrame library. Choose where it should be. You can move it later in Settings > Storage.

This folder is in your own user folder, outside Documents. Windows does not sync it to OneDrive, so cloud syncing can never lock or replace your files while you work. Back up this folder.
